problemStatement:
A commercial selectorized cable machine redirects two equal cable tensions through an adjustable pulley. Analyze the circular axle that transfers the pulley load into two supporting bracket plates.

Use stack mass ms = {{pulley_m_s_kg}} {{pulley_m_s_kg_unit}}, ideal cable ratio r = {{pulley_r}}, pulley mass mp = {{pulley_m_p_kg}} {{pulley_m_p_kg_unit}}, axle diameter d = {{pulley_d_mm}} {{pulley_d_mm_unit}}, included cable-force angle theta = {{pulley_theta_deg}} {{pulley_theta_deg_unit}}, and accidental dynamic coefficient kd = {{pulley_k_d}}. Use fixed g = 9.81 m/s2.
engineeringGoal: Determine average axle double-shear stress for pulley dead load, normal full-stack live load, and the simplified accidental/transient case; identify the governing scenario; and state what the average-stress comparison does and does not establish.
